现有游戏画风和立绘比例参考

options.label: 贴近原照
options.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve and style-transfer.
Asset type: one transparent character sprite candidate for Mao Lang 毛狼 in the Chinese visual novel 《毕节，雨停之前》.
Input image 1 is the USER'S REAL-PERSON PHOTO, the sole identity/likeness reference. Input image 2 is the EXISTING GAME SPRITE, used ONLY for painterly rendering, body scale, lighting and portrait framing; do NOT inherit image 2's facial identity, wavy hairstyle or olive jacket.
Primary request: replace the old fictional Mao Lang's visual appearance with the man shown in image 1. Preserve the recognizable visible facial proportions of image 1: natural dark alert eyes and upper lids, straight dark eyebrows, exposed forehead and temple/ear shapes, normal unidealized skin. He must look like a painted version of the photo subject, not a generic handsome anime man.
Preserve image 1's black low-profile bucket hat with the small white embroidered mark, pale blue pleated medical mask correctly covering nose and mouth, black oversized short-sleeved T-shirt with its fine pale abstract line pattern, black crossbody strap, slim forearms, dark trousers. The mask stays ON; do not invent or reveal the lower face. Hair mostly covered by the hat. No added jacket.
Style: match image 2's detailed semi-realistic Japanese visual novel illustration, natural adult anatomy, softly painted skin and fabric, restrained fine contours, muted gray-teal ambient lighting plus subtle warm amber highlights. Maintain the likeness while making a finished painted game sprite. No glossy idol beautification, no giant anime eyes.
Composition: ONE adult male figure, preferred 1024x1536 portrait canvas, head to upper thighs, complete hat and hands, clean side margins and space above the hat.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha outside the figure; skin and clothing opaque. No scenery, train, furniture, backdrop, floor shadow, gradient, halo or glow, no baked-in checkerboard. No captions, text labels or watermarks. No extra people, duplicated limbs, fused fingers or unrelated props.
Option A — PHOTO-FAITHFUL, QUIET CASUAL POSE. Preserve the photograph's slight three-quarter face orientation looking a little toward viewer's right, calm attentive eyebrows and eyes, natural casual demeanor. Translate the seated reference into a relaxed upright waist/upper-thigh portrait without a chair: shoulders gently angled, elbows relaxed; both hands loosely hold the single plain white smartphone at waist height, phone screen turned inward and no visible screen content. T-shirt hangs naturally and the crossbody strap follows the photographed direction. Keep the mask and photo identity especially faithful. Refined small details, understated expression.
